topics.topic: Whether RuntimeSettings must be imported/exported with its schema or removed from the note
questions: Must RuntimeSettings be exported from app.models by IMPORTS and its schema made available, or must the note stop requiring the field name from = models.RuntimeSettings?

The passage must either name RuntimeSettings only after it is declared as this module's imported model dependency, or remove the RuntimeSettings reference and state the required diagnostic behavior without that undeclared symbol.
Either RuntimeSettings must be exported through IMPORTS with its field surface supplied, or the note must stop requiring information from = models.RuntimeSettings.
Declare RuntimeSettings as a direct models dependency so its symbol and schema reach this module, or remove the RuntimeSettings reference from the note.
Either RuntimeSettings must be supplied as model data or imported with its field surface, or the note must stop requiring the unavailable RuntimeSettings field name.
Either RuntimeSettings must actually be exported by IMPORTS, or the omission rationale must no longer call it an imported runtime model schema.

quotes: probe_backup_location: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST answer a ProbePassed when the probe file was created and removed, and otherwise a StartDiagnostic whose diagnostic names the backup_dir item by the name of the backup_dir field of = models.RuntimeSettings, as every start diagnostic names an item, and what failed, the location missing or not a directory or the file not created or not removed, never the location's path; a probe file it could not remove MUST be left where it is, for the next run's removal of temporary files.
judgement.why: The positive note names RuntimeSettings as a foreign model symbol even though this module's declared imports explicitly do not export it, so the dependency must be declared or the reference removed.

author_guidance: Before editing, identify the decision's owning state from the phase purpose, question_scope and layer obligations, then choose a disposition for each topic that awaits one.
fixed: repair a decision the owning state must make; do not add later-layer implementation choices merely to close a topic. Record the fix commit and review the changed text once.

carried: name the receiving layer and use --what to preserve the choice, its options and consequences, and the required guarantee every option must keep. Decide any guarantee owned here before carrying its execution onward.
accepted: explain why the remaining choice is permitted. Bring an unresolved product choice to the owner with its options and consequences; absence of a quoted requirement does not decide it.
contradiction and standard_violation take no disposition: repair the offending text in its owning state and review the change. Deterministic transition findings must also close through their checks.

For an enum-to-enum lookup, resolve the typed table before rewriting the note (SPEC_STANDARD §15.2 and §6.10 v2). Use python tools/design_enum_map.py template --help, fill rows, then preview and apply in the case checkout.
